description: Does NspC constrain the diamine answer: packing and PLP distance for each nitrogen of the norspermidine product bound in PDB 3N29, the only NspC structure with product
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def parse_cif_atoms(txt):
    lines=txt.splitlines(); i=0; atoms=[]; cols=[]
    while i<len(lines):
        if lines[i].strip()=='loop_' and i+1<len(lines) and lines[i+1].strip().startswith('_atom_site.'):
            cols=[];j=i+1
            while lines[j].strip().startswith('_atom_site.'): cols.append(lines[j].strip().split('.')[1]); j+=1
            while j<len(lines) and not lines[j].startswith('#'):
                p=lines[j].split()
                if len(p)==len(cols): atoms.append(dict(zip(cols,p)))
                j+=1
            break
        i+=1
    return atoms
at=parse_cif_atoms(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/3N29.cif",timeout=120).text)
def xyz(a): return np.array([float(a['Cartn_x']),float(a['Cartn_y']),float(a['Cartn_z'])])
nsd=[a for a in at if a['label_comp_id']=='NSD']
chains=sorted({a['auth_asym_id'] for a in nsd})
print("3N29 norspermidine (NSD) copies in chains:",chains)
prot=[a for a in at if a['group_PDB']=='ATOM' and a['type_symbol']!='H']
PX=np.array([xyz(a) for a in prot])
plp=[a for a in at if a['label_comp_id']=='PLP']
rows=[]
for ch in chains:
    L=[a for a in nsd if a['auth_asym_id']==ch]
    LX=np.array([xyz(a) for a in L]); LN=[a['label_atom_id'] for a in L]
    P=np.array([xyz(a) for a in plp if a['auth_asym_id']==ch])
    if len(P)==0: P=np.array([xyz(a) for a in plp])
    Ns=[i for i,n in enumerate(LN) if n.startswith('N')]
    # rank the three nitrogens by distance to the PLP C4A (site of Schiff base / decarboxylation)
    c4a=[xyz(a) for a in plp if a['label_atom_id']=='C4A' and (a['auth_asym_id']==ch or True)]
    ref=c4a[0] if c4a else P.mean(0)
    order=sorted(Ns,key=lambda i:np.linalg.norm(LX[i]-ref))
    for rank,i in enumerate(order):
        d=np.linalg.norm(PX-LX[i],axis=1)
        rows.append(dict(chain=ch,atom=LN[i],rank=['proximal (nearest PLP C4A)','central','distal'][rank],
                         d_PLP_C4A=round(float(np.linalg.norm(LX[i]-ref)),2),
                         n_prot_within_4A=int((d<4).sum()),n_within_6A=int((d<6).sum()),n_within_8A=int((d<8).sum()),
                         nearest_prot_A=round(float(d.min()),2)))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); df.to_csv("nspc_3N29_pocket.csv",index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",220); print(df.to_string(index=False))
agg=df.groupby('rank',sort=False)[['d_PLP_C4A','n_prot_within_4A','n_within_6A','n_within_8A','nearest_prot_A']].mean().round(2)
print("\nmean over the",len(chains),"copies:"); print(agg.to_string())

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(10.5,4.0))
o=['proximal (nearest PLP C4A)','central','distal']
x=np.arange(3); w=0.26
for k,(c,lab) in enumerate(zip(['n_prot_within_4A','n_within_6A','n_within_8A'],['4 A','6 A','8 A'])):
    axes[0].bar(x+(k-1)*w,[agg.loc[r,c] for r in o],w,label=f'within {lab}')
axes[0].set_xticks(x); axes[0].set_xticklabels(['proximal\n(decarboxylated end)','central','distal'],fontsize=8.5)
axes[0].set_ylabel('protein heavy atoms'); axes[0].legend(frameon=False,fontsize=8)
axes[0].set_title('Packing around each norspermidine nitrogen\nin PDB 3N29 (NspC with product bound)',fontsize=9.5)
for s in ('top','right'): axes[0].spines[s].set_visible(False)
axes[1].bar(x,[agg.loc[r,'d_PLP_C4A'] for r in o],0.5,color='#4393c3')
axes[1].set_xticks(x); axes[1].set_xticklabels(['proximal','central','distal'],fontsize=8.5)
axes[1].set_ylabel('distance to PLP C4A (A)')
axes[1].set_title('The distal amine sits far from the catalytic centre\nand is the least enclosed of the three',fontsize=9.5)
for s in ('top','right'): axes[1].spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
